༄༅/ /thod rgal gyi yang yig nam mkha' klong gsal bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thod rgal gyi yang yig nam mkha'

klong gsal bzhugs so/ / nam mkha' klong gsal zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po gdod nas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od gsal ye shes rigs lnga'i bdag /'khor 'das kun gyi dpal du gyur/ /kun tu bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod ma'i 'od gsal snying po las/ /kun tu bzang grol sems can 'khrul/ /'khrul pa'i ldog tshul 'bras bu rnams/ /rgyud lung man ngag ji bzhin bshad/ /dang po gdod ma'i spyi gzhi ni/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum/ /stong gsal 'char gzhi ma 'gags pas/ /nam mkha' nyi zla me long bzhin/ /ye nas lhun grub chen por gnas/ /'khor 'das gnyis su ma chad pas/ /'char gzhi 'char gnas lung ma bstan/ /chos kun 'byung ba'i gzhi zhes bya/ /rang rig nyid dang 'du 'bral med/ /yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir/ /bde gshegs snying po zhes su bshad/ /ngo bo stong pas rtag ma myong*/ /rang bzhin gsal bas chad ma myong*/ /thugs rje rig pas bems stong min/ /gcig dang tha dad las grol ba'i/ /dbyer med sku gsum 'du 'bral med/ /rang bzhin gzhi yi sangs rgyas so/ /sangs rgyas mar me mdzad pa dang*/ /gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur/ /'od dpag med ces bya bar btags/ /de ni gdod ma'i gnas lugs so/ /de las gzhi snang shar tshul ni/ /dper na shel las 'od shar ltar/ /gzhi yi ngang las gzhi snang shar/ / de yang gzhi yi rtsal gsum ste/ /ngo bo'i rtsal ni go 'byed yul/ /rtog med nam mkha'i ngang nyid du/ /rang bzhin rtsal ni kha don lnga/ /ye shes rang gdangs phyed par shar/ /thugs rje'i rtsal ni shes rig tsam/ /yul 'byed nus pa'i tshul du shar/ /de ni grol 'khrul gnyis kyi gzhi/ /nges pa med pa'i lhun grub bo/ /de tshe rang snang rang rig pas/ /skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed/ /skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /kun tu bzang po'i grol tshul lo/ /snang ba'i ye shes rang 'od la/

/rang ngo shes pas lhan cig pas/ / lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'char/ /shes bzhin lung ma bstan bcom nas/ / ye sangs rgyas la yang sangs rgyas/ /gdod ma'i dbyings su mthar phyin nas/ /kun gyi sngon rol ston pa byon/ /lam ston phyir na thugs brtse bas/ /nus pa ye shes phrin las rdzogs/ /ma rig sems can 'khrul tshul ni/ /gzhi snang shar tshe rang snang du/ /rang las shar ba ma rig pas/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig byung*/ /'od lngas yul lus 'khrul gzhir byas/ / thugs rjes sems kyi 'khrul gzhi shar/ /ngo bo ma rig 'khrul gzhi byung*/ /de tshe 'od lnga'i snang ba la/ /gzhan 'dzin rtog par 'gyus pa ni/ /kun tu brtags pa'i ma rig go /rkyen bzhi'i dmigs pa ma dag pas/ /gzugs med gzugs dang 'dod khams kyi/ /srid par 'khrul snang sna tshogs myong*/ / dha du ra nyid ma shes par/ /khong du zos pas 'khrul snang bzhin/ /bde sdug snang srid snod bcud shar/ /yang na sna tshogs rmi lam bzhin/ /gnyid gcig las byung sna tshogs pas/ /rig pa nyid steng 'khrul snang shar/ /shar dus 'khrul snang 'khrul 'dzin kun/ /grub pa med de snang ba tsam/ /de ltar 'khrul pa'i sems can la/ /gdod ma'i 'od gsal snying po ni/ /chad dang lhag pa med par gnas/ /sems can kun gyi snying dbus na/ /rang rig stong gsal rig pa nyid/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje ste/ /chos sku longs sku sprul skur gnas/ /nang dbyings rnam dag sgron ma'i klong*/ /rig pa sku dang thig le zer/ /lu gu rgyud dang bcas pa nyid/ /'du 'bral med par ngang gis gnas/ /de yang rang rig mi g.yo ba/ /ye shes gsum gyi rang bzhin phyir/ /sku gsum lhun grub dbyings su gcig /rig pa'i ngang dwangs rlung 'dres pas/ /kun gzhi'i rnam shes tshogs dang bcas/ /'khor ba'i 'du byed nyid du shar/ /rtsa ba'i gnas ni rlung can grong*/ /de las nang gi rtsa 'dab dang*/ kha sna'i sgor ni 'gyu ba'i rta/

/rig gdangs mi zhon sems zhes bya/ /yul drug 'dzin las nyon mongs skyes/ /de las 'khor ba 'du byed yin/ /de ni 'khrul dus gnas tshul lo/ /'khrul ba ji ltar ldog tshul la/ / 'khrul snang 'khrul 'dzin sems las byung*/ /des na sems nyid dag bya'i phyir/ /ye shes nyid la goms par bya/ /de yang rig pa'i ye shes nyid/ / goms pas sems 'gags 'khrul par stong*/ /de phyir phan tshun spang 'gal gyi/ /sems dang ye shes dbye bar bya/ /lam ni sgron ma bzhi goms pas/ /snang ba bzhi po mthar phyin nas/ /tshe 'dir grol ba brtson 'grus rab/ /'bring rnams bar do tha ma rnams/ /rang bzhin sprul par grol tshul gyis/ /gdams pa gsum la nan tan bya/ /dang po tshe 'di'i gdams ngag la/ /dam pa'i bla ma mnyes byas te/ /spros bcas spros pa med pa dang*/ /shin tu spros med rab spros med/ /rnam pa bzhi po rdzogs byas nas/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes rnams kyi/ /gdams khrid dag ni rdzogs par bya/ /dang po dben pa'i gnas song la/ khregs chod thod rgal don bsgom mo/ /de yang lta stangs gzigs stangs bstun/ /rlung gnad rab tu dal ba las/ /'og rlung cung zad bsdam par bya/ /des ni bde chen ye shes 'char/ /sgron ma bzhi yi snang ba la/ /ma yengs bsam pa zad par blta/ /sgron ma rnam bzhi 'di lta ste/ /dag pa dbyings kyi sgron ma dang*/ /rgyang zhags chu yi sgron ma dang*/ /thig le stong pa'i sgron ma dang*/ /shes rab rang byung sgron ma 'o/ /dbyings la rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /phyi dbyings nam mkha' sprin bral la/ /nang dbyings rnam dag sgron ma 'o/ /de yang snying dbus 'od lnga yi/ /pho brang mu khyud bcas pa'i gdangs/ /phya ི yi nam mkha' 'ja' tshon lnga'i/ /klong na 'od zlum mu khyud ris/ /pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi bzhis brgyan/ /g.yo 'gul shas ni chung bar gnas/ /rgyang zhags chu yi sgron ma ni/ /mig gnyis a 'bras dwangs pa'i dkyil/

/'od gsal 'char sgo'i dwangs ma ste/ /'od rtsa'i sna nyid zug pa 'o/ /'dis ni ye shes snang ba 'dzin/ /'khrul snang mi 'dzin gdangs dang ldan/ /me long ye shes sgo zhes bya/ /mig gi dbang rten dngas pas ni/ / 'khrul snang 'dzin phyir 'khor ba yi/ /rnam shes nyid du bshad pa yin/ /chu yi sgron mes ye shes kyi/ /snang ba 'dzin phyir ma 'khrul bas/ /dag pa'i rang bzhin nyid du bshad/ /des na 'di gnyis phyed pa gces/ /thig le stong pa'i sgron ma ni/ /mtheb mdzub rtsol bas snang ba yi/ /dmar ser ye shes lnga yi 'od/ /mu khyud dag dang yang dag ldan/ /'di ni rang gsal sgron ma ste/ /ci zhig tsam na rtsol med par/ /dbang po'i yul la snang dus na/ /mtshan mo'ang nyin bzhin snang bar byed/ /shes rab rang byung sgron ma ni/ /'od snang der gtad mi 'gul tshe/ /nang du rang rig spros dang bral/ /stong gsal chos nyid ngang la gnas/ /rang gsal mi rtog chen po las/ /shes rab sna tshogs rang rdol du/ /rang bzhin babs kyis shar ba ste/ /bde gsal mi rtog nyams dang bcas/ /rang byung gdod nas dag mnyam gyi/ /dgongs pa mngon du gyur pa yin/ /de tshe nang gi bdag nyid ni/ /mi g.yo spros dang bral ba yis/ /gsal snang thod rgal ye shes la/ /rang gzhag 'phro 'du zhi ba ni/ khregs chod stong pa lhun gyis grub/ /sems 'gag cha ni khregs chod dang*/ /ye shes rang gsal thod rgal gnyis/ /zung 'jug rang byung ye shes te/ /snying tig gsang ba'i lam du bshad/ /gang tshe spros kun nyer zhi'i tshe/ /rang rig ye shes mngon par snang*/ /de phyir don 'di shes par bya/ /deng sang dus kyi sgom chen phal/ /rtog pa khol bur 'ching 'ching nas/ /mi rtog ye shes ngos ma zin/ / sems gnas bzang yang gong ma yi/ /bsam gtan gzugs med rnam bzhir gol/ /snying tig bsgom par 'dod pa yi/ /rnal 'byor pa yang de dang 'dra/ / yang na chad pa nam mkha' 'dra/ /legs kyang gzugs med zhi gnas tsam/

/ yang na rtag pa ther zug pa/ /'dod la zhen pas bsam gtan du/ /gol ba'i rigs kyang shin tu mang*/ /des na rtag chad las grol ba'i/ /ye shes mchog 'di shes par mdzod/ khregs chod thod rgal so so ru/ /zhen nas nyams len byed pa de/ /dmus long gzugs la mjal ba 'dra/ /dbyings rig ma go gzu lums can/ /mgrin bzang rnams kyi grogs po yin/ /gang tshe chos nyid 'od gsal mchog /rnam kun mchog ldan goms pa las/ /mngon sum gong 'phel tshad phebs dang*/ /zad pa'i snang ba mthar phyin nas/ /gdod ma'i rang bzhin mngon du gyur/ /dang po chos nyid mngon sum ni/ /rig pa'i rang 'od mkha' dbyings su/ /thig le thig phran snang ba nas/ /lu gu rgyud kyi 'dabs 'byor du/ /thig le sum sbrel tshun chad do/ /de tshe sems kyang gzung sar zin/ /'dab chags snyi la zin pa bzhin/ /'phro bar snang yang gnas pa yin/ /gnyis pa nyams snang gong 'phel ni/ /snang ba de kun gong du mched/ / dra ba dra phyed mchod rten dang*/ /za 'og ber khyim la sogs pa/ /snang ba'i 'od kyi lung pa khengs/ /thig le'i nang du yi ge dang*/ /phyag mtshan thor tshugs la sogs gsal/ /sems kyang 'phro 'du shas chung ba/ /rim gyis zin pa'i mi ltar 'gyur/ /ye shes rang rig sngon bsags la/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul ting 'dzin 'grub/ /gsum pa rig pa tshad phebs ni/ /sku yi snang ba shar ba de/ /rang lus 'od du grol gyur nas/ /ri brag rnams la zang thal lo/ /sems kyang mi 'phro rlung dag phyir/ /'brum nad byang ba lta bu ste/ / bskyar nas 'ong ba med pa bzhin/ /rnam rtog phyis ni skye ba min/ /bzhi pa chos nyid zad pa ni/ /rdos bcas lus dang sems rtog zad/ /snang ba'i 'phel zad chos dbyings ngang*/ /rtag tu 'pho 'gyur med par gnas/ /sems dang sems byung 'gyu ba nub/ /kun gzhi ches phra'i dri ma dag /de tshe skye dang 'jug pa la/ /rang dbang nyid ni thob pa'o/ /'jug pa bems por snang ba

la/ /rig pa bcug pas cho 'phrul ston/ /skye ba'i rang dbang thob pa ni/ / dbyings su nub pa'i skad cig la/ /sems can sum stong rig pa bcug / gdod mar grol ba'i 'bras la sbyor/ /de ni de yi yon tan no/ /de nas gdod mar rnam grol 'gyur/ /de dag tshe 'di'i nyams len no/ /gnyis pa bar dor grol tshul ni/ /lhun grub rang gnas gzhi de nyid/ /sgrib byed las sems bral ba'i tshe/ /ji ltar gnas pa de ltar snang*/ /de yang ngo bo stong pa yi/ /rang bzhin mi rtog 'od gsal gzhi/ /rnam shes 'od gsal thim tshe 'char/ /snang ba'ang sna tshogs rang snang la/ /rang ngo shes pas rnam par grol/ /de nas lhun grub 'od gsal ni/ /rigs lnga'i rang bzhin mtshan dper ldan/ /tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor snang ba ni/ /rang bzhin nyid kyi snang ba'o/ /de nas ye shes bzhi sbyor ni/ /'od kyi snam bu mngon par snang*/ /de yang rang bzhin gdangs su bshad/ /de nas lhun grub rin po che/ /thugs rje'i rang snang 'char tshul ni/ /yar la grol gzhi chos sku'i dbyings/ /thad kar rang snang longs sku'i zhing*/ /mar la 'gro drug 'khrul ba'i gzugs/ /de tshe rang ngo shes na grol/ /rang snang 'gro 'dul thub pa yis/ /'khrul snang stong pa'i don mdzad nas/ /longs sku sprul skur thim pa nyid/ /chos sku ka dag gdod ma'i sa/ /gzhon nu bum pa'i ngang du thim/ /nang gsal mi g.yo spros bral pa/ /chos sku bsam med brjod 'das las/ /longs sku phyir snang don mdzad do/ /de tshe rang ngo ma shes na/ /'gro drug gnas su 'jug pa ste/ /srid pa'i bar do nyid mthong nas/ /las kyi mtho ris ngan 'gror 'phel/ /'khrul snang bde sdug nyid la spyod/ /de bas rang ngo shes par gces/ /rgyas par gzhan du bstan pa yin/ /gsum pa sprul skur grol tshul ni/ /chos nyid bden pa mthong ba yi/ /byin rlabs mngon sum gnad nyid kyis/ /mngon dga' dpal ldan pad+ma brtsegs/

/las rab grub pa'i zhing lnga ru/ /bgrod de pad+ma'i snying po las/ /brdzus skyes mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /mi bskyod rin chen 'od dpag med/ /don yod rgyal pos dbugs dbyung ste/ /bar do med par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'di ni dbang po tha ma rnams/ /grol ba'i thabs de ngo mtshar che/ /gsum pa 'bras bu'i grub tshul ni/ /gdod ma'i 'od gsal nyi ma la/ /sgrib pa'i dri ma lus ngag sems/ /shin tu dag tshe yon tan mchog / lhun grub mngon du snang ba la/ /byang chub sangs rgyas zhes su brjod/ /de tshe phyi nang 'byung ba rnams/ /dbyings su zhi bas lha mo lnga/ /phung po rnam dag sangs rgyas lnga/ /rtog tshogs dag pas sems dpa'i tshul/ /rang lus rnam dag gzhal yas khang*/ /yul snang dag pa zhing khams nyid/ /nyon mongs dag pa ye shes lnga/ /stobs bcu mi 'jigs ma 'dres chos/ /ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs pa nyid/ /gang na'ang dpe med drang srong che/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med/ /chos sku dpag yas nam mkha' 'dra/ /longs sku 'od gsal nyi zla bzhin/ /sprul sku sna tshogs chu zla bzhin/ /'khor ba ji srid don mdzad do/ /nor bu bum bzang dpag bsam gyi/ /shing bzhin lhun grub don kun mdzad/ /sems dang sems byung rab 'gags pas/ /rnam par rtog med spros kun zhi/ /ye shes rang bzhin mngon gyur bas/ /ji snyed ji bzhin kun tu mkhyen/ /ye nas lhun grub mngon gyur pas/ /'dus ma byas shing 'pho 'gyur med/ /rab zhi byang chub ye shes ni/ /grol ba kun gyi 'bras bur bzhed/ /de ltar rdo rje snying po yi/ /theg pa'i rang bzhin gsal byas pas/ /ma lus skye dgu thams cad kun/ /kun tu bzang po'i sa thob shog /'di ni rnam dag legs pa'i lam/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas byang chub sbyor/ /de phyir skal ldan mkhas rnams kyis/ /goms pa mthar phyin mdzad du gsol/ /dpal ldan yon tan mdzod 'chang ba/ /klong chen rab 'byams rnal 'byor bas/

/snying tig gsang ba'i gnas bsdud nas/ /phyi rabs don du legs par bkod/ / dge bas 'bad med yongs grol te/ /mthar phyin don gnyis lhun grub shog /thod rgal gyi yang yig nam mkha' klong gsal zhes bya ba theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (10)thod rgal gyi yang yig nam mkha' klong gsal/ - PAGE 2 -- PAGE 9 -- PAGE 1 -
